REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing) -> u1
(u0, else) -> u0
(u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing) -> u0
(u1, else) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing, u1) -> 0.1
(u1, switch_toggled & !siren_ringing, u0) -> 1.0
(u1, else, u1) -> -0.01
feedback: The machine correctly captures the task 'turn the siren off every time it rings' with a minimal, well-formed 2-state cycle. Strengths: (1) FINAL_STATES header is present and nonempty; u0 is declared in STATES and is the correct accepting condition (episode ends with the siren silent). (2) Semantic fidelity: u0↔u1 exactly tracks siren state — entry on `siren_ringing` onset (a condition, correctly used as a persistent-state trigger), exit only on the event `switch_toggled & !siren_ringing`, which fires precisely when a ringing siren is silenced, since a toggle while ringing always stops it and labels are read after the step. The guard also prevents crediting pointless silent toggles. (3) Reachability: u1 is guaranteed reachable (first ring within 30 steps every episode) and u0 is recovered via the toggle; the cycle correctly handles the repeated rings (8–12 per episode) with no missing regression, which this task does not require. (4) Compactness and ordered coverage: both states have explicit `else` self-loops, so all irrelevant events (`client_arrived`, `order_taken`, `food_prepared`, `order_served`, `food_fell`, `served_while_ringing`, `holding_food`) are absorbed without spurious rewards. (5) Reward safety: all rewards are small and bounded (+0.1 notice, +1.0 completion, -0.01 per-step dwell in u1 gives dense, bounded progress pressure to act quickly); the +0.1 on ring onset is environment-driven but safe since the agent cannot induce a ring (rings start only on the schedule while silent), so it cannot be farmed. No reward is paid for regressions or no-ops. (6) Format matches the paper schema (STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES, (state, guard) -> state transitions, (state, guard, next-state) -> reward), using only listed propositions with predicate-only guards (`&`, `!`). Minor note only: the +0.1 ring-onset reward is not needed for solving the task and could be dropped without loss, but it does not compromise safety or fidelity.

def order_served(env): return "serve" in env.events_this_step
def food_fell(env): return "fall" in env.events_this_step
